en.title: Wasup vs ManyChat — WhatsApp Copilot Compared
en.description: Compare Wasup and ManyChat for WhatsApp: local BYOK drafts with human approval vs cloud automation SaaS. See pricing, privacy, and workflow differences.
en.h1: Why switch from ManyChat to Wasup?
en.intro: ManyChat is a cloud automation platform. Wasup is a desktop WhatsApp copiloto: AI drafts from your FAQs, you approve before send, sessions stay on your PC.
en.whySwitch: If you need WhatsApp replies with human control and local privacy — not another contact-tier chatbot cloud — Wasup is built for that loop.
